from pathlib import Path
import starlette
print('workspace import:', starlette.__file__)
assert Path(starlette.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(Path.cwd().resolve())
import subprocess,sys
script = """import importlib.abc,sys,warnings
blocked=sys.argv[1].split(',') if sys.argv[1] else []
class Block(importlib.abc.MetaPathFinder):
 def find_spec(self,fullname,path=None,target=None):
  if any(fullname==name or fullname.startswith(name+'.') for name in blocked):raise ModuleNotFoundError(fullname)
sys.meta_path.insert(0,Block())
if sys.argv[2]=='strict':warnings.simplefilter('error',PendingDeprecationWarning)
from starlette import formparsers,requests
print(blocked,formparsers.multipart,requests.parse_options_header)
if len(blocked)==2:
 assert formparsers.multipart is None and requests.parse_options_header is None
else:
 assert formparsers.multipart is not None and callable(requests.parse_options_header)
"""
for blocked,mode in (("", "strict"),("multipart", "normal"),("multipart,python_multipart", "normal")):
    result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-c",script,blocked,mode],capture_output=True,text=True)
    print(result.stdout,result.stderr)
    assert result.returncode==0,(blocked,result.stderr)
